name: create-github-repo
summary: Create a GitHub repository (public with ai-dev-tools-like defaults, or private bare).
permissions: Run the authenticated gh CLI against api.github.com to create repositories and configure settings/rulesets.
Read skill templates under this tool directory and write substituted seed files into a local working tree for the new public repo.
Run git init/add/commit/push (and gh repo create --source) only for the new repository's first seed commit on public creates.
Does not read, store, or print GitHub tokens; relies on existing gh authentication.
sideEffects: Creates a new GitHub repository under the authenticated user (or an owner/name the user can admin).
For public repos: mutates repository settings, Actions permissions, vulnerability reporting, creates branch/tag rulesets, and pushes a seed commit with SECURITY.md, PR template, and CODEOWNERS.
For private repos: creates the repository only (no rulesets, no seed files).
Never force-pushes, never enables auto-merge, never merges pull requests.
